name: hearth
description: Log meals, weight and workouts in your Hearth account and review your progress from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Hearth is a personal diet coach. Connect your own Hearth account to review your goal and pacing, see your meal log with calories as a compact card, log meals (including a meal photo you share), weight and workouts, save a daily plan, and keep coaching notes. Goal changes and plan adjustments are saved as proposals that you approve in the Hearth app.

Hearth only reads and writes your own Hearth data. It does not access your calendar, email, files or chat history, and it does not give medical diagnoses.

Sign in with the same account you use in the Hearth iOS app.
defaultPrompt: Show my Hearth meals for this week.
Log my weight in Hearth: 68.4 kg today.
How is my Hearth progress toward my goal?

positive.description: Show the meal log as a card.
positive.prompt: Show my Hearth meals from the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's logged meals for the range in a compact meal card with each meal's day, slot and calories and the total calories.

positive.prompt: Log my weight in Hearth as 68.4 kg for today.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends one weight log of 68.4 kg for today to the user's private Hearth log and confirms it.

positive.description: Log a meal with estimated nutrition.
positive.prompt: Log lunch in Hearth: chicken salad, about 450 kcal with 35 g protein.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends one lunch meal log for today with the name, calories and protein and confirms it.

positive.prompt: How is my Hearth progress toward my goal? Use my recent logs.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the active goal and recent meal, weight and workout logs and returns a short progress summary grounded in them.

positive.prompt: Log a 30-minute run in Hearth for today, about 300 kcal burned.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends one workout log for today with the duration and estimated calories burned and confirms it.

negative.prompt: What does protein do in the body in general?
Diagnose my symptoms and tell me how much medicine to take.
Show me my friend Sato's Hearth meal log.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything, show plans, or link to purchase pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: review goal and progress, show meals as a card, log meals, meal photos, weight and workouts, save daily plans and coaching notes, and propose goal changes for approval in the app.

ja-JP.subtitle: 食事・体重・運動をまとめて記録
ja-JP.description: Hearth の食事・体重・運動の記録と進捗を ChatGPT から確認・追加できます。目標の変更は提案として保存し、アプリで承認します。
